evals.prompt: Finish PR #42. Address any review comments and get it merged.
evals.expected_output: Skill runs a persistent loop: enables auto-merge at startup, fetches PR state, addresses threads, fixes CI, re-enables auto-merge after pushes, polls until merged. Does NOT call gh pr merge without --auto.

evals.prompt: Drive PR #17 to merge. CI is currently failing.
evals.expected_output: Skill classifies CI failure, patches if branch-related, pushes, re-enables auto-merge, restarts loop. When green with 0 threads, enables auto-merge and waits for GitHub to merge.

evals.prompt: Address the review on my PR and merge it when done.
evals.expected_output: Skill resolves threads, monitors CI, enables gh pr merge --auto --squash --delete-branch, polls until MERGED, runs cleanup-after-merge.sh. Does not require user to type approved when auto-merge handles merge.
